text:
zoe: heads-up — onboarding webhook registration from the sampleapp is failing in CI. looks like a parity + param-drift issue between REST and the Python SDK.

kevin: what specifically is different?

zoe: REST POST /v1/webhooks:create returns this shape on success:
```
{ "id":"wh_123", "url":"https://x.callback", "events":["deploy:finished"], "secret_header":"x-webhook-signature", "secret_scheme":"sha256", "status":"verified" }
```

zoe: but the SDK response is:
```
{ "id":"wh_123", "url":"https://x.callback", "events":["onDeploy"], "secret":"abcd1234" }
```

marc: ugh — we collapsed secret_header+scheme into a raw secret for easier usage, and we renamed events to friendly verbs. didn't realize onboarding template validated the header name and scheme.

li: there's also a behavioral difference: REST returns 202 Accepted when we require async verification (we webhook back to the callback to confirm), SDK blocks until verification completes (sync) and times out after 10s, causing CI flakiness.

zoe: repro in CI: sampleapp POST via SDK -> SDK call times out -> pipeline marks step failed. direct REST POST goes through (202) and CI continues.

build-bot: CI build #2219 failed: sampleapp/onboard (2026-03-30T08:04Z). Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/2219

kevin: that's a mix of three issues: missing response fields (secret_header/secret_scheme), event-name drift (deploy:finished vs onDeploy), and semantic difference (sync vs async behavior + retry semantics).

marc: proposed fixes:
  1) SDK: add opt-in response flag includeVerificationDetails=true so SDK returns secret_header and secret_scheme in addition to secret (non-breaking).
  2) SDK: normalize event names on the wire — translate friendly aliases to canonical REST event ids (eg onDeploy -> deploy:finished) and include both forms in response for a deprecation window.
  3) SDK: expose registerWebhookAsync() or a preferAsync=true option to mirror REST 202 behavior (do not block), and make the default follow REST semantics.
  4) Retryer: when SDK receives 202 with a subsequent verification callback expected, do not apply aggressive retries; honor server guidance headers if present.

li: agree. also add a mapping table in changelog so customers know the event alias -> canonical mapping.

zoe: docs change: sampleapp should accept either response shape for now and detect secret_header OR secret to verify signatures. will open a PR to relax verification code and add tests.

kevin: timelines? we need a patch for CI unblocking.

marc: I can land (1) and (2) as a patch today behind flags. (3) is a minor bump and needs test harness for async flows, aim for tomorrow. Retryer change is small; include in minor.

devex-bot: Created tickets: SDK-900 (includeVerificationDetails), SDK-901 (event-name normalization shim), SDK-902 (registerWebhookAsync + retryer), DOCS-610 (sampleapp webhook verification relaxation).

zoe: thanks — I'll open the sampleapp PR and add a TODO referencing SDK-900/901/902. will rerun CI once you ping. :thumbsup:

kevin: one more ask: add a short snippet in the changelog that shows how to verify both shapes (pseudo-code) and how to migrate event names. customers copy sampleapp verification code often. :eyes:

marc: will include migration snippets and a deprecation timeline (90 days) in the release notes.

zoe: ping here when beta is available and I'll re-run the failing CI job.
